name: 吳和庭
objective:
本課程由老師指導學生選定題目，進行該題目之問題定義、分析、設計與製作。專題完成後需撰寫書面報告並公開展示成品。專題範圍包含：1. 多媒體系統 2. 電腦網路 3. 軟體分析與設計 4. 影像與音訊處理 5. 微算機應用
In this course, the instructor will guide the students to fulfill a special project through the phases of problem formulation, analysis, design and implementation. The final work should be demonstrated in the public along with a written report. The topics include 1.Multimedia systems 2.Computer networks 3.Software analysis and design4.Audio and video signal processing 5.Microprocessor-based applications
schedule: 由專題老師與學生各別討論後制定
scorePolicy: 通常以繳交報告或口頭報告根據學生表現來評定
materials: 透過書籍或網路找尋相關參考資料
consultation: 由專題老師與學生各別討論後制定
課程對應SDGs指標: SDG9：產業創新與基礎設施（Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure）
課程是否導入AI: ● 鼓勵學生使用生成式 AI 工具（Encourage students to use generative AI tools）

延伸教學與資源: ● 參與式創新教學 (Participatory & Innovative Teaching) 強調學生參與與產出，導入翻轉、PBL/專題、設計思考或遊戲化等策略。Emphasizes student engagement and outcomes by adopting strategies such as Flipped Classroom, PBL (Problem/Project- Based Learning), Design Thinking, or Gamification.● 數位教材資源應用 (Application of Digital Resources) 採用影音多媒體或具開放授權之資源（如 OCW、開放教科書）作為主要或輔助教材。Adopts multimedia or open-licensed resources (e.g., OCW, Open Textbooks) as primary or supplementary teaching materials.
課程對應SDGs指標: SDG1：消除貧窮（No Poverty）SDG8：尊嚴就業與經濟發展（Decent Work and Economic Growth）SDG17：夥伴關係（Partnerships for the Goals）
